d: As Americans head to the polls for the 2026 US midterm elections, the economy is emerging as a key issue shaping the contest. While the Trump administration has taken steps to curb immigration, concerns over the cost of living, inflation and economic uncertainty continue to weigh on voters. With all 435 seats in the House of Representatives, 35 Senate seats and 36 governorships at stake, the results could reshape the final two years of Donald Trump’s presidency. How much will the state of the US economy influence the midterm verdict?
